data.title: 神罚 · 细雨午后的被窝相拥
data.description: 窗外细雨蒙蒙打在玻璃上，昏暗温暖的卧室内两人紧裹在厚被子中。针织裙半滑下香肩，肌肤相贴温热发烫，她在你耳边带着微红双颊软语撒娇，满眼深情。
data.location: dimly lit cozy bedroom with rain on window
data.action: lying in bed tangled under blankets, sweater slipping off shoulder, soft skin contact, blushing cheeks, whisper at ear
data.lighting: dim diffuse rainlight contrasted with warm bedside lamp glow
data.promptProse: Tangled beneath soft bedsheets on a rainy afternoon, Modernia blushes with bare shoulders as she cuddles close and whispers tenderly.
data.animaCaption: Modernia cuddling intimately in bed under blankets on a rainy day.
